(function(){
  function hideA1Splash(){
    var x=document.getElementById('a1Splash');
    if(!x || x.dataset.hidden==='1') return;
    x.dataset.hidden='1';
    setTimeout(function(){
      if(!x || x.dataset.hidden!=='1') return;
      x.classList.add('hide');
      setTimeout(function(){
        if(x && x.parentNode) x.parentNode.removeChild(x);
      },500);
    },3000);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',hideA1Splash,{once:true});
  else hideA1Splash();
})();
</script>

<script>

let items=[];
let bills=[];


function showTab(id){

document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(function(p){
p.style.display="none";
});

document.getElementById(id).style.display="block";

}



function addItem(){

let name=document.getElementById("itemName").value;
let qty=Number(document.getElementById("itemQty").value);
let price=Number(document.getElementById("itemPrice").value);


if(!name || !qty || !price){
alert("Enter item details");
return;
}


items.push({
name:name,
qty:qty,
price:price,
total:qty*price
});


renderItems();


document.getElementById("itemName").value="";
document.getElementById("itemQty").value="";
document.getElementById("itemPrice").value="";

}



function renderItems(){

let box=document.getElementById("billItems");

let html="";
let total=0;


items.forEach(function(i,index){

total+=i.total;

html+=`
<div class="card">
${i.name}<br>
Qty: ${i.qty}<br>
Price: ₹${i.price}<br>
Total: ₹${i.total}

<button onclick="removeItem(${index})">
Delete
</button>

</div>
`;

});


box.innerHTML=html;

document.getElementById("billTotal").innerHTML=total;

}



function removeItem(i){

items.splice(i,1);

renderItems();

}



function saveBill(){

let bill={

customer:
document.getElementById("customerName").value,

mobile:
document.getElementById("customerMobile").value,

address:
document.getElementById("customerAddress").value,

items:items,

amount:
Number(document.getElementById("billTotal").innerHTML),

date:new Date().toLocaleString()

};


bills.push(bill);


localStorage.setItem(
"a1Bills",
JSON.stringify(bills)
);


updateDashboard();

alert("Bill Saved");


}


function updateDashboard(){

document.getElementById("totalBills").innerHTML=bills.length;


let total=0;

bills.forEach(function(b){
total+=b.amount;
});


document.getElementById("totalAmount").innerHTML=total;

}



function printBill(){

window.print();

}



function saveSettings(){

let data={

name:
document.getElementById("companyName").value,

phone:
document.getElementById("companyPhone").value,

address:
document.getElementById("companyAddress").value

};


localStorage.setItem(
"a1Settings",
JSON.stringify(data)
);


alert("Settings Saved");

}


window.onload=function(){

let old=localStorage.getItem("a1Bills");

if(old){

bills=JSON.parse(old);

}

updateDashboard();

}

</script>

</body>
</html>let A1DB = {

save:function(key,data){

localStorage.setItem(
key,
JSON.stringify(data)
);

},


get:function(key){

let d=localStorage.getItem(key);

return d ? JSON.parse(d) : null;

},


remove:function(key){

localStorage.removeItem(key);

}

};



function loadBills(){

let data=A1DB.get("a1Bills");

return data || [];

}



function generateInvoice(){

let bills=loadBills();

let last=bills[bills.length-1];

if(!last){

alert("No Bill Found");

return;

}


let text=

"A1 DECOR INDIA\n\n"+
"Customer: "+last.customer+"\n"+
"Mobile: "+last.mobile+"\n"+
"Address: "+last.address+"\n\n"+
"Items:\n";


last.items.forEach(function(i){

text+=
i.name+
"  "+
i.qty+
" x "+
i.price+
" = "+
i.total+
"\n";

});


text+=
"\nTotal Amount: ₹"+
last.amount;


return text;

}



function shareInvoice(){

let invoice=generateInvoice();


if(navigator.share){

navigator.share({

title:"A1 Decor India Bill",

text:invoice

});

}

else{

alert(invoice);

}

}
